title: NEUROSCAN: Clinical Brain MRI Tumor Diagnostic Engine with Explainable AI (Grad-CAM) and From-Scratch Convolutional Architecture
description: NEUROSCAN is an AI project for brain tumor detection and classification in T1 contrast-enhanced axial MRI scans under the faculty supervision of Dr. Syed Wajid Alam.
